# Carnival Glam Hub

Carnival Glam Hub is an award-winning premium Carnival beauty concierge for travelling masqueraders. One location, one schedule, everything handled: sweat-resistant Carnival makeup, hair styling, getting-dressed assistance, professional photoshoots, refreshments, an air-conditioned waiting lounge, and shuttle service in select territories. Founded in 2017 by Gabrielle Waite (celebrity makeup artist, "Gabby Glam") and Kibwe McGann. Headquartered in Kingston, Jamaica. Trusted by 15,000+ masqueraders since 2017.

## Booking and Registration
Register and pay your deposit by territory and date at the official booking page: https://carnivalglamhub.masos.app/events
Get an instant price quote: https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/booking-calculator
Email: carnivalglamhub@gmail.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +1 876 509 0997

## Pricing
Carnival morning access (getting dressed, lounge, shuttle where it runs): US$35.
Makeup only: US$170 to US$210 for a single day, US$380 for both Trinidad days.
Named and celebrity artists: US$200 to US$580.
Photoshoot only: US$140 to US$160.
Carnival hair: US$120 to US$220.
Full Glam: US$430 to US$680.
Jamaica, 4 April 2027: makeup only US$200, makeup and photoshoot US$320, Full Glam US$440, photoshoot only US$160, hair only US$120, bronzing US$160, Gabby Glam Team makeup only US$250, Gabby Glam Team makeup and photoshoot US$370, Jamaica Glam Reel US$80. Book: https://carnivalglamhub.masos.app/events/0ad062ce-d1e0-4838-aeaf-f418ed526440
Tobago, 1 November 2026: makeup only US$120, makeup and photoshoot US$220, photoshoot only US$100. Book: https://carnivalglamhub.masos.app/events/755be168-61a2-4827-9e9e-d52668a790ff

## Station Rentals for Service Providers
Independent makeup artists and hair stylists can rent a station inside a Carnival Glam Hub for Carnival morning. Available in every territory with a season still to come, Full Service and Lite. Glam Hub Lite territories (currently Grenada, Tobago and Atlanta; Saint Lucia, Antigua, Barbados, Toronto and Guyana return with next season's dates): US$200 per station per day, multi-day rates confirmed on enquiry. Full Service territories (Trinidad, Jamaica, Miami): US$250 per station per day, US$400 for both days. Every station comes with a 6ft truss table, a table cloth, access to a plug and 2 regular chairs, inside the air-conditioned lounge, with reception and check-in for your clients, a changing room, wing and bag check while your clients are with us space permitting, and the territory's refreshments. The station spec is identical at both tiers; what differs is the hub around it. Your clients get access to all the hotel and location amenities available to Glam Hub masqueraders in that territory. Providers bring their own kit, products, clients, high chair, ring light, and their own extension cord and multiplug, no exceptions. Optional extra: high chair rental at US$25 per day. Payment is by Zelle, PayPal or a secure online Stripe link, with details sent when the station is confirmed. A station is for makeup artists and hair stylists only. No other provider type is offered. Enquire: https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/station-rentals

## Vendor and Merchandise Spaces
Separate from a station rental. A space inside the Glam Hub to sell products to masqueraders on Carnival morning, typically Monday wear, costume accessories and merchandise. A vendor space is not a station; a station is a working chair for a service provider. What the vendor gets: the space, plus access to card processing at the hub, so no terminal is needed. Anything beyond that is confirmed on enquiry. Rates: US$250 per day, US$400 for both days, the same flat rate at every Glam Hub, Full Service and Glam Hub Lite alike. The vendor rate does not derive from the hub tier. Enquire: https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/station-rentals#vendor-spaces

## Reputation
Rated 4.8 out of 5 across 43 Google reviews.

## Glam Hub Tiers
Full Service Glam Hub (Jamaica, Trinidad, Miami): shuttle, wing and bag check while you are with us, space permitting, breakfast and refreshments, alcohol, makeup, hair, seamstress, changing room, photoshoot, coffee and tea. Bronzing is available in Trinidad and Jamaica. Reels are a paid add-on in Trinidad and Jamaica at US$80 per masquerader. Overnight bag check is a paid add-on at US$35 per masquerader in Trinidad, Jamaica and Miami. In Miami you can collect your bag at the hotel that night or early the next morning, or opt for delivery the following day at additional cost, confirmed when you book. Exception: we are not running a shuttle in Miami this season, because the Glam Hub is 6 minutes from the Carnival and the venue has ready Uber access, so Miami masqueraders plan their own ride. Jamaica and Trinidad also offer a barber.
Glam Hub Lite (all other territories, including Saint Lucia, Grenada, Antigua, Barbados, Toronto, Guyana, Tobago and Atlanta): makeup, photoshoot, changing room, wing and bag check while you are with us space permitting, coffee, tea and light refreshments. Glam Hub Lite does not offer getting dressed, seamstress, overnight bag check, shuttle, hair, bronzing, reels, alcohol or breakfast. Grenada is the one exception: it offers dressing assistance, and still no seamstress.

## Destinations
Territories are only bookable while their Carnival is still ahead of us. Once a season has passed, that territory closes and the page points to the gallery until the next season's dates are confirmed.

Currently bookable:
Trinidad Carnival, 8 and 9 February 2027 https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/trinidad
Trinidad Carnival 2027 https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/trinidad-carnival-2027
Jamaica Carnival, Sunday 4 April 2027 https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/jamaica
Miami Carnival, 11 October 2026 https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/miami
Miami Carnival has moved to Broward County. As announced by Miami Carnival, the Parade of Bands is at Central Broward Park and Broward County Stadium, 3700 NW 11th Place, Lauderhill, Florida 33311, sometimes listed as the Fort Lauderdale cricket stadium. The city is Lauderhill, not Fort Lauderdale. Our Glam Hub will be at a hotel in Lauderhill, 6 minutes from the Carnival. We are not running a shuttle in Miami this season. At 6 minutes from the Carnival, with ready Uber access at the venue, a shuttle is not needed, so please plan your own ride on Carnival morning. Overnight bag check is a paid add-on at US$35 per masquerader. You can come back to the hotel that night or early the next morning and collect your bag yourself, or opt for delivery the following day at additional cost, confirmed when you book. Lauderhill is about 6 miles from Fort Lauderdale, roughly a 12 minute drive, and about 26 miles from Miami, so Fort Lauderdale is the closer airport and the closer place to stay.
Grenada Spicemas, Monday 9 and Tuesday 10 August 2027 https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/grenada
Grenada is taking a pre-registration only. It is US$50 per masquerader, it closes on 31 December 2026, and it secures your spot for Spicemas 2027. It is not a full booking and no service is included, because no Grenada makeup, hair or photoshoot price exists for 2027 yet. Hosted at the Radisson Hotel, central in Grenada, with the band route starting outside the hotel. Grenada remains a Glam Hub Lite, covering makeup, photoshoot, dressing assistance, a changing room, wing and bag check while you are with us space permitting, and snacks, coffee, tea and light refreshments. There is no seamstress, hair, shuttle, breakfast, alcohol, bronzing, barber, reels or overnight bag check in Grenada. Pre-register: https://carnivalglamhub.masos.app/events/19940fc1-1fa1-4d34-8a7b-a4c3562df100
Tobago Carnival, 30 October to 1 November 2026 https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/tobago
Epic Cruise Trinidad Carnival, February 2027 https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/epic-cruise
Atlanta (Glam Hub Lite, no confirmed date yet, enquire on WhatsApp https://wa.me/18765090997)

## Policies
Full Terms of Service, refund and cancellation policy and Privacy Policy: https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/policies
A non-refundable deposit of US$50 per masquerader, per appointment, is required in every territory to confirm a booking.
No refund is given for a cancellation within 14 days of the event. No shows and same-day cancellations forfeit all payments.
A booking may be transferred once, to any Carnival Glam Hub event within 12 months, requested at least 3 days before the event. Transfers may cross territories.
Register at the hub no later than 30 minutes before your appointment. A 15 minute grace period applies, after which the service may be shortened or cancelled. There is no cash late fee.
Booking and rescheduling questions are also answered on the FAQ page: https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/faq
